main_timer: At 0x00e7e6c7-0x00e7e6d7, store record[0x1c] = record[0x1c] - delta unconditionally before 0x00e59c10.
After the four-slot loop, 0x00e7e750 executes COMISS XMM1,record[0x1c] with XMM1 equal to zero.
0x00e7e754 JC is taken when zero is less than the timer, which includes an ordered-positive timer. COMISS also sets CF for an unordered result, so NaN takes the same branch.
Ordered-positive and unordered/NaN main timers call 0x00e7ba30 directly and do not read the global selector.
Only an ordered non-positive timer falls through to the selector read. Selector equality calls 0x00e7ba30; selector inequality writes zero to record[0x1c] and goes to 0x00e7e130.
per_slot: 0x00e7e714 executes COMISS slot,zero and 0x00e7e717 JBE skips unless the slot is ordered positive. Zero, negative, and NaN slots are not decremented.
For an ordered-positive slot, 0x00e7e719-0x00e7e722 computes and stores the raw remaining value before the next comparison.
0x00e7e71f executes COMISS zero,remaining and 0x00e7e726 JBE skips for ordered zero, ordered positive, and unordered NaN remaining values.
Only an ordered-negative remaining value falls through. The target writes zero to the slot at 0x00e7e734 and calls 0x00e7b540 with slot index 0, 1, 2, or 3.
If 0x00e7b540 returns AL==0, the target calls 0x00e7e130 immediately. Otherwise it advances to the next slot.
